subject: Contribute Your Work to the New INLA Website!

messages.author: fda1962767a2614c
messages.subject: Contribute Your Work to the New INLA Website!
parts:
Dear INLA community,

We are excited to share that a new INLA website is under development, with a redesigned examples page that will highlight applied use cases of INLA. As part of this effort, we warmly invite members of the community to contribute R examples based on their research.

Why contribute an example?

1. Your example will be featured on the new INLA examples page, giving your work greater visibility.
2. We will include a citation link to your paper, so readers can easily reference and cite your work.
3. Examples may also be adapted for the upcoming Python wrapper to INLA, extending their reach to an even broader audience.

We welcome simple examples that demonstrate the key ideas from your work. For reference, a template example is attached, though you are free to adapt or expand it as you see fit.

If you would like to contribute, please send your example (or any questions) at esm...@r-inla.org or he...@r-inla.org.

Best regards,
Esmail
